title: Control the coding work
summary: Step 1 done (review): the supervisor now enforces its rules in all ten deliberate-failure cases, with fixture workers and no model calls. Real-task proof (Sol) and application visibility remain.
body: Became current 2026-09-27 after Lohith accepted checkpoint-memory. Uncommitted work already exists in the folder: devcontrol/, CODING-CONTROLS.md, CONTROL-TEST-RESULTS.md, RECOVERY-PLAN.md, scripts/dev-control.ps1, tests/test_devcontrol*.py. It has not been reviewed or accepted. 2026-09-27 authorization (Lohith): 'you may go ahead with the current checkpoint work, I wont disturb you with questions.' Bounded task: fix the two failing devcontrol controls (success claimed without any check; verifier writing outside scope), run the ten step-1 deliberate-failure cases with local fake workers only, and record observed results in CONTROL-TEST-RESULTS.md. Excluded: real Sol task, paid model calls, application runs. Clarified with Lohith: the supervisor enforces rules (scope, deadline, stop, frozen checks), not quality; quality acceptance stays with Lohith on real output. RESULT 2026-09-27: fixed four defects: completion with no acceptance check; verifier writing outside scope; stop ignored during verification; Windows liveness check killing the checked process (also affected the workspace lock). All ten cases observed as expected via scripts/devcontrol_step1_evidence.py; devcontrol tests 18 pass. One unexplained transient mismatch (tampering case read RUNNING) in 1 of 4 full runs, 0 of 10 isolated reruns. Evidence: CONTROL-TEST-RESULTS.md step 1. Not yet done: step 2 (one real Sol task, paid model call, needs Lohith's go-ahead), step 3 (application visibility). CODING-CONTROLS.md still describes the older tracker-steps authorization.
next_action: Report step-1 results to Lohith in five points; ask before step 2 (real Sol task, uses paid model allowance).
change_reason: Record step-1 control evidence and fixed defects
